title: Realtek SDK miniigd SOAP UPnP Command Execution (Mirai Botnet Vector)
description: The miniigd SOAP service in Realtek SDK allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted NewInternalClient requests to the UPnP service on port 52869/52881. This is a primary propagation vector for the Mirai botnet.
remediation: Disable UPnP on WAN/LAN interfaces and upgrade router/gateway firmware.

title: TP-Link Smart Plug Unauthenticated Local Network Command Execution
description: TP-Link Smart Plug HS100/HS110 devices listen on TCP port 9999 using a weak XOR autokey cipher with no authentication, allowing any device on the local network to control the relay switch or extract Wi-Fi configuration.
remediation: Segment smart plugs into an isolated IoT VLAN without lateral access to enterprise/workstation subnets.

title: Generic Unencrypted IoT Telemetry & Anonymous Broker Disclosure
description: MQTT broker allows anonymous unauthenticated clients to subscribe to wildcard topics ('#') and publish spoofed sensor or control messages.
remediation: Require TLS encryption (port 8883) and enforce client certificate authentication or username/password authentication.
